glossary.name: Avengers
glossary.summary: A Hero team. In the core box its members are Black Widow, Captain America, Hawkeye, Hulk, Iron Man and Thor.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Spider Friends

glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: X-Men
glossary.summary: A Hero team. In the core box its members are Cyclops, Emma Frost, Gambit, Rogue, Storm and Wolverine.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Foes of Asgard
glossary.summary: An Ally team of enemies of Thor's home realm. In Villains its members are Enchantress and Loki.

glossary.name: Covert
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters who prefer trickery and careful plans to open force.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Instinct
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters who trust their gut and their senses in close combat.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Ranged
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters who deal damage from a distance, by any kind of projected power.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Strength
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters whose power is might, whether of body or of will and leadership.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Tech
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters whose power comes from gear and science rather than the body.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Covert
glossary.summary: An Ally class that wins through deceit, cunning schemes and subtle powers.

glossary.name: Instinct
glossary.summary: An Ally class that relies on ferocity, fast reactions and keen senses.

glossary.name: Ranged
glossary.summary: An Ally class that attacks from afar with blasts, beams and elemental or mental power.

glossary.name: Strength
glossary.summary: An Ally class whose power is raw might, iron will or command of others.

glossary.name: Escape
glossary.summary: Triggers when this Villain is shoved past the final city space and escapes, in addition to the standard escape penalties.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Fight
glossary.summary: Triggers when a player spends enough Attack to defeat this card.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Rescue a Bystander
glossary.summary: Add a Bystander from the shared Bystander stack to your Victory Pile, where it scores at game end. This never frees a Bystander a Villain holds; defeat that Villain for it.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Thrown Artifact
glossary.summary: An Ally that stays in front of you between turns once you play it. On your turn, put it on the bottom of your deck to use its throw ability.

glossary.name: Uru-Enchanted Weapons
glossary.summary: Before fighting this enemy, reveal one Adversary Deck card per weapon; it gains Attack equal to their Victory Points. Fall short and the fight fails, ending your fighting this turn.

glossary.name: Fight or Fail
glossary.summary: Resolve this effect whether you defeat the enemy or its Uru-Enchanted Weapons make the fight fail.

glossary.name: Always Leads
glossary.summary: Names the Adversary Group or Backup Adversary group this Commander brings to every game. It takes one of the setup's group slots; random draws fill the rest.

glossary.name: Ambush
glossary.summary: Triggers as this Adversary arrives in the city. If its arrival pushes another Adversary out, resolve that overrun first.

glossary.name: Command Strike
glossary.summary: When a Command Strike comes off the Adversary Deck, the Commander acts in person: resolve the Command Strike line on its card, then KO the Strike.

glossary.name: Commander Tactic
glossary.summary: Beating the Commander's Attack takes one of its four face-down Tactics at random for your Victory Pile, with its Fight effect. Taking all four wins.

glossary.name: Demolish
glossary.summary: Reveal the Ally Deck's top card and move it to the bottom; every player then discards a card that costs the same, if they have one.

glossary.name: Fight
glossary.summary: Triggers when a player spends enough Attack to defeat this card.

glossary.name: Overrun
glossary.summary: Triggers when this Adversary is pushed out past the last city space, after it KOs a cheap Ally from the Lair and any guarded Bystanders cost each player a discard.

glossary.name: Plot Twist
glossary.summary: Drawing a Plot Twist from the Adversary Deck moves the Commander's plan forward: resolve the Twist line on the Plot, then KO the Twist unless the Plot says otherwise.
